To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
PfFNT inhibition by the compounds identified in our screens leads to parasite swelling and death, and that PfFNT inhibitors can be used to select for PfFNT mutant parasites.

the ‘Malaria box’ chemical library was screened for compounds which perturb parasite pH, and 15 compounds were identified that induce an acidification of parasite cytosol, and 2 of which were shown to inhibit the parasite’s formic acid transporter, PfFNT.

PfFNT inhibitors were found by screening a large library of compounds for their effect on the pH of the parasite cytoplasm, and that these compounds were shown to block lactate efflux from the parasites and to cause the parasites to swell.
